title: VA PTSD program with flashing images and air horns

tellings.quote: And they put me in this weird program back in 2016, 2017 where they're flashing images and air horns.

plain: Around 2016 and 2017, the Department of Veterans Affairs put a former Air Force serviceman named Dylan Borland into an odd treatment programme for post-traumatic stress, one where, in his words, "they're flashing images and air horns." Borland tells Michels this as something done to him, points to his VA medical records, and links the programme to Langley. Told this way, it suggests the treatment was more than ordinary therapy.
